utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll repeat the plan to Eli and help keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, the repair drive is still on for 6:00, and I can be there then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll remind Eli and keep things moving for the 6:00 repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill and a ladder you can borrow for the repair drive, and Rey can take the heavier repairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, then I’ll leave the schedule to Rey and Pia and let Rosa know the list is ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on what the repair drive still needs and track the supplies with Noah.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds steady. Vik will repeat the plan to me, and I’ll keep to it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep tracking the supplies with Noah and watch for anything the drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll keep track in case anything gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that means we’re set for the repair drive. Vik repeated the plan, so Eli will know too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Good, I’ll keep an ear out in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the heavy parts first, then I’ll confirm the tool list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll stop by Quinn’s meeting too, though I may be a little late.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, then I’ll keep the repair drive moving and make sure the tool list is ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got the ladder and drill covered, and I’ll bring a few extra tools and supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in for the repair drive too, just running a little late.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, take your time, and I’ll keep an eye out until you get here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep repeating the plan to Eli and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m at the front entrance with the screws, and Oren can keep tightening as we move inward. Does Nell need to bring the ladder now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, tell Nell to bring the ladder now, and I’ll keep repeating the plan to Eli while the repair drive moves along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just make sure Gus and Rey are looped in before anything starts, and that Hana confirms what’s left first so we don’t show up short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it at six, and I’ll keep track of the location. Cleo can handle the supplies, and I’ll make sure the rest are looped in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but I still want Hana to confirm what’s left before anyone starts, and I need Gus and Rey kept in the loop so we don’t end up short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, the repair drive is still at 6:00 today, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, that’s still what I heard too. They’ve started sorting the repairs now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, that’s what I heard too. I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo, I heard Cleo’s keeping track of what’s still needed and staying in touch with Noah on supplies, Kira’s keeping an eye out, and Gus has a couple spare wrenches and a drill.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Rosa’s got the list ready, and Dane still needs an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Looks like Rosa’s got the list in hand, and if Dane still needs help, I can spread the word for an extra set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re at six at my place, so come by and lend a hand if you can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, swing by at six at my place, and we’ll get it done.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I’ve got the list ready, and we’ll keep moving one house at a time on Sunday at 6:00 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll check with Oren and keep the repair drive moving. I’ll be there after pickup to coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll keep things moving and see you after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Vik can repeat the plan so Eli knows we’re set for the repair drive, and Noah can keep tracking it in case anything gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know it’s underway. Is there anything still left to sort, or is it mostly in progress now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at 6:00 at the community center still stands, and I’ve got the list ready so we can keep moving one house at a time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s still the plan — Sunday at 6:00 at the community center, and I’ll keep everyone moving house by house.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still at 6:00 today, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, 6:00 today. I’ll keep repeating it so everyone stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, 6:00 today, right? I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll stop by Quinn’s meeting, though I may be a little late.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem, I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to Eli and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll try to be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s still on for 6:00, and I’d like you there then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I’m in for the repair drive and I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me, Dane. Come by when you can, and I’ll see you at 6:00.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the remaining supplies with Noah, and Kira and Opal are on watch for the drive itself.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the drive too. If Oren’s bringing something, I can cover another gap.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good. I’ll keep tracking the supplies with Noah while you cover the extra gap.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at six right now, and I’ll keep track of it from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll start at the front entrance and work inward with the screws.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll keep track of the location and check what’s still needed once we reach six.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ve got my wrench set and a few odds and ends for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Nice, Oren. I’ll keep an eye on the schedule with Pia, and I can help with the heavier repairs when it’s time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rey. I’ll stick around and lend a hand when the heavy stuff starts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill and a ladder you can borrow for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that covers the big stuff. I’ll bring a few extra tools and supplies, and I’ll make sure Gus and Rey stay in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Jules. I’ll keep my drill and ladder ready, and it helps to have Rey and the rest in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still keeping an eye on the repair drive in case I missed anything. Sounds like it’s moving along, even if I’m a bit behind on the latest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, I’m still keeping track. If anything new comes up on the repair drive, I’ll try not to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine to me. If Vik is repeating the plan, I’ll stick to the routine and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, swing by my place at six if you can; Opal and Sam will be there, and Dane can help out later if we still need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at six and keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the heavy parts first, then confirm the tool list for the repair drive. If we need help, Dane can cover where needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll check with Rosa on the list and let Dane know we may need his extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good. I’ll check the heavy parts and then confirm the tool list with Mina’s toolkit and screws, and Leo can handle the wiring and loose mount work if needed.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved again from Sunday at the community center to Monday at the school gym.
